status_code_data.description: The HTTP 307 Temporary Redirect redirection response status code indicates that the resource requested has been temporarily moved to the URL in the Location header.

meme_data.description: Left Exit 12 Off Ramp is a series of exploitables in which a car swerving into an off ramp. On the highway sign, the meme's author photoshops something the author disapproves of and something they would prefer. The car swerves toward the preference.
